title: SQL Server: with VIEW DATABASE STATE revoked, a row written after ADD COLUMN never arrives, with no error

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard gateway, one run per arm

symptom: With VIEW DATABASE STATE revoked from the ingestion login, the gateway logged "Detected a schema change", and the row written after the ADD COLUMN was absent after two updates. No error appeared in the events or the updates. The control without the revoke delivered the row after the second update.
effect: Rows are lost silently after a schema change.
fix: Keep VIEW DATABASE STATE on the ingestion login. Whether a full refresh recovers the row wasn't tested.
notes: One run per arm. VIEW DATABASE STATE implies VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE, so revoking only the second changed nothing (see the integrated permission record).
